topic: Your Busiest Season Is About to Start
objective: Address the scenario of preparing finance ahead of a known seasonal peak.

slides.headline: What does it mean?
slides.body: If your peak season is predictable, so is the extra stock, staffing and cash flow it requires. Arranging finance ahead of the rush — rather than during it — means you're ready to move the moment demand picks up.

caption:
If you know your busy season is coming, the extra cash-flow demand it creates is just as predictable — which means it can be planned for well in advance, rather than addressed under time pressure once the rush has already started.

Getting a facility arranged ahead of time means you can focus entirely on trading once the season actually begins.
